candidates.change_summary: Return a different storage slot constant by replacing the returned value with a different bytes32 constant.
Invert the delegation check so proxiableUUID can return a different value path by allowing delegated calls to proceed (which changes behavior when called via proxy).

Removed the onlyInitializing restriction by deleting the onlyInitializing-modifier invocation from the internal call to __Access_init, allowing initialize to be callable without initialization context and thus change _initialized behavior.
Prevented the initializer modifier from setting _initialized to 1, leaving the stored _initialized unchanged during initialization which changes post-initialize observed initialization state.

Replace the branch that computes utilization when block.timestamp > utilizationData.lastUpdate so that utilization is always computed from the vault's currentUtilizationIndex difference without the elapsed division, changing returned rate.
When block.timestamp > utilizationData.lastUpdate, set elapsed to 1 instead of actual elapsed, affecting multiplier adjustments and returned rate.
If block.timestamp > lastUpdate, skip updating utilizationData.index (so index remains stale), changing subsequent rate calculation.
When not in the > lastUpdate branch, call currentUtilizationIndex and use it for utilization instead of IVault.utilization, altering returned value.
Change the kink validation from rejecting kink==0 to rejecting kink<=0 (i.e., use <= instead of ==) to alter which slope inputs are accepted and thus stored by setSlopes.
Remove the kink lower-bound check so kink==0 is permitted, changing acceptance of inputs and thus stored slopes.
Invert the kink upper-bound check to accept only kink < 1e27 (use > instead of >=), thereby rejecting kink==1e27 and accepting previously rejected values differently.
After storing the slopes, also set slope0 to zero unconditionally, changing the stored slope values observed after setSlopes.

Change the stored slopes assignment to store slope1 instead of the whole struct, effectively modifying the stored data observed after setSlopes (by only updating slope1 field and leaving others unchanged).
